import sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'benchmarks/suites')
from cross_model_manifold_alignment import load_features,verify_id_alignment,procrustes_residual
root=Path('docs/research/b0927c-t1-geom-audit')
old=json.loads(Path('benchmarks/results/manifold_alignment_qwen72b_vs_llama70b_13tasks.json').read_text())
rows=[]
for task in old['tasks']:
    paths=[Path('/ebs/data/extracted_features/qwen72b/features')/(task+'.npz'),Path('/ebs/data/extracted_features/llama70b')/(task+'.npz')]
    a,b=[load_features(p) for p in paths]
    verify_id_alignment(a,'qwen',b,'llama')
    rec={'task':task,'models':[]}
    grams=[]
    for name,p,d in zip(['qwen72b','llama70b'],paths,[a,b]):
        with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as z:
            info=json.loads(str(z['info_json']))
            keys=z.files
        sha=hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()
        x=d['test_full'].astype(float); xc=x-x.mean(0); g=xc@xc.T
        eig=np.linalg.eigvalsh(g)
        norms=np.linalg.norm(x,axis=1)
        dup={k:int(len(d[k])-len(np.unique(d[k]))) for k in ('train_ids','test_ids')}
        r={'model':name,'path':str(p),'sha256':sha,'shape_train':list(d['train_full'].shape),'shape_test':list(x.shape),'keys':keys,'info':info,'duplicate_ids':dup,'train_test_id_overlap':len(set(d['train_ids'])&set(d['test_ids'])),'norm_cv':float(norms.std()/norms.mean()),'participation_ratio':float(eig.sum()**2/(eig@eig)),'historical_hash_matches':sha==old['per_task'][task].get('sha256_a' if name=='qwen72b' else 'sha256_b')}
        rec['models'].append(r); grams.append(g)
    g,h=grams; rec['cka_gram']=float(np.sum(g*h)/np.linalg.norm(g)/np.linalg.norm(h))
    rec['procrustes']=procrustes_residual(a['test_full'],b['test_full'])
    expected=next(x for x in old['per_task'][task]['blocks'] if x['block']=='test_full')
    rec['cka_abs_diff_historical']=abs(rec['cka_gram']-expected['linear_cka'])
    rec['procrustes_abs_diff_historical']=abs(rec['procrustes']-expected['procrustes_residual'])
    assert rec['cka_abs_diff_historical']<1e-7
    assert rec['procrustes_abs_diff_historical']<1e-7
    rows.append(rec)
    print(task,'n=',len(a['test_ids']),'cka=',round(rec['cka_gram'],6),'proc=',round(rec['procrustes'],6),'PR=',[round(x['participation_ratio'],2) for x in rec['models']],'normCV=',[round(x['norm_cv'],4) for x in rec['models']],flush=True)
(root/'feature-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'13 tasks test geometry; all train/test ID alignment; no learned adapter or dynamics','numpy':np.__version__,'rows':rows},indent=2))
print('PASS 13 real feature pairs; historical test metrics reproduced; no curvature or dynamics claim')
